name: Sesame Crusted Chicken with Snap Pea, Cucumber & Cilantro Salad
ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger; place in a medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the ginger.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with oil and salt; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Place sesame seeds and cornstarch in another medium bowl; stir to combine.

Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Spread mayo over both sides of the chicken, then dredge in the sesame coating, pressing gently to adhere. Transfer to a plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add the chicken and cook until the coating is golden and chicken is cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut snap peas crosswise into thin pieces, add to the bowl, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
